lines.zh: 我走得慢，脑子里在想事。
lines.en: I walk slowly, my mind elsewhere.
My boots are worn. I will replace them later.
I walk with my head down, careful not to tread on anyone.

lines.zh: 其实我不用走，可我想走走。
lines.en: I could fly, but I want to walk.
I have dreamed this road.

lines.zh: 我把手插在兜里，装得很普通。
lines.en: Hands in my pockets, trying to look ordinary.
My shoulders feel heavy — not from a pack.
I go step by step, steady.

lines.zh: 我不想让人看见我出手。
lines.en: I do not want anyone to see me fight.

lines.zh: 衣角被风吹起来，我按住。
lines.en: Wind lifts my hem; I hold it down.
I stop halfway along the path.

lines.zh: 脚下踩着落叶，声音很好听。
lines.en: Dry leaves crackle nicely underfoot.
I stand still, secretly gathering ki.
A quiet place like this is good.

lines.zh: 我在想该怎么打才不伤人。
lines.en: I am thinking how to win without hurting anyone.
My palms are still damp.
I breathe deep and steady myself.

lines.zh: 我抬头看云，想起很多人。
lines.en: I look at the clouds and think of many people.
I roll my sleeves up.
This body is still growing.
I am not good with words. Sorry.
I clench my fist, then release it.
Dust on the wind.
I touch my hair. Messy.
I dislike being stared at.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，气反而更稳。
lines.en: Standing still, my ki settles.
Hello — there is no need for us to fight.
Your ki is calm. You are decent, right?
I do not want to fight.
Step back a little, please?
My name is Gohan.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，是从很远来的？
lines.en: That garb — are you from far away?
I can tell you are strong.
If possible, let us talk.
My hands are already shaking.
Do not let children see this.
I take a breath before speaking.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛告诉我你要动手。
lines.en: Your eyes say you will strike.
I dislike this atmosphere.
I feel your hostility.
After you.
I will not throw the first punch.
Does anyone else live nearby?

lines.zh: 我不想让人受伤，包括你。
lines.en: I want no one hurt — including you.
I can bear this much.
I press the wound and rise.
Pain whitens my vision.
Half a step back, I settle my ki.
I cannot fall yet.
I swallow the blood.
The Masenko leaves my palm.
Again—my legs aren't weak yet.
Food? I am not very hungry.
That is not right — it belongs to someone.
Thank you. I will take a little.
My mother's cooking is better.
I eat fast. Sorry.
This will last me a day.
You need not try to please me.
I save half for someone else.
Sorry, I wasn't watching my step.
Are you all right?
I step back to let you pass.
Narrow path — easy to collide.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀不小心碰到了。
lines.en: My shoulder caught you by accident.
Do not be angry.
As long as neither of us fell.
I lower my head in apology.
Next time I will keep to the edge.
That is — I am still young.
This sort of thing—I don't really get it.
Stop asking. I blush.
I have not thought that far ahead.
I drop my head.
When all this is over.
Right now I only want to protect everyone.

lines.zh: 我摇摇头，笑得有点尴尬。
lines.en: I shake my head, smiling awkwardly.
Can we change the subject?
That is not for me to answer.

lines.zh: 这枚果子掉了，我捡起来。
lines.en: A fallen fruit — I pick it up.
I crouch and brush the dirt aside.
Whose is this? I should return it.
I put it in my pocket.
Only after lifting it do I feel the weight.
I pat the dust off.
It might be useful.
I cradle it in my hands.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，没人认领。
lines.en: I look around. No one claims it.
All right. I will take this seriously.
Do not push me.
I have set my feet.

lines.zh: 你伤到人了，我不能不管。
lines.en: You hurt someone. I cannot stand aside.
I lower my stance and raise my ki.
This will end quickly.
I do not want to win — I cannot afford to lose.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，头发轻轻扬起来。
lines.en: I look up; my hair lifts slightly.
I keep your ki in my fist.
Sorry. I am coming.
I clench my fist; ki leaks between my fingers.
I will not kill.
Stop.
You still have a chance to leave.
I do not like this choice.
My books are still on my shoulder. Come on.
I am reading your movement.
Your weight has shifted.
I wait for your first strike.
You are faster, not steadier.
I gather ki behind me.
Do not wreck what is around us.
People live where you are retreating.
I must stand between.
Your line is very straight.
I turn and give half a step.
I will not start — but I will answer.
The Masenko is still charging.
Your breathing has grown loud.
One step closer and I block.

lines.zh: 就这样，别伤到旁的东西。
lines.en: Just so — spare everything else.
When I get serious, my ki changes.
Masenko — my palm is already hot.
I throw a punch — lightly.
That was only to push you back.

lines.zh: 我踢你的手腕，不是要害。
lines.en: I kick your wrist, not a vital point.
You cannot block it; I held back.
I knock your bracer aside.
I pull back and do not pursue.
My fist lands on your sword.
I shove you away without full contact.
The ki blast skims the ground.
I recover my fist and stand.
Sorry, that one was heavy.

lines.zh: 连击的时候我一直在收力。
lines.en: Through the combo I kept pulling my blows.
I lower my hands.
Do not come again.

lines.zh: 我从云里落下来，稳稳站住。
lines.en: I drop out of the clouds and land steady.
Is everyone here all right?
I came when I heard the fighting.
Do not be afraid. I am not an enemy.
My landing flattened the grass.
Pardon the intrusion.
I unclench my fist.
My ki has not settled yet.
This is my first time here.
I still carry a schoolbag on my back.
I was only passing through.
You are injured.
Is there something I can do?
I do not intend to transform this time.
I step in front of you all.
The wind has messed my hair.
I'm here; the Masenko arrives first.
My clothes are scorched; I beat out the flame.

lines.zh: 落地时我弹了一下，膝盖疼。
lines.en: I bounce on landing; my knees hurt.

lines.zh: 水太深，我憋得胸口发疼。
lines.en: Too deep — my chest aches for air.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推远，我稳住脚。
lines.en: The blast throws me; I steady my feet.

lines.zh: 一颗弹丸打穿了我的肩。
lines.en: A shot punches through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 怪异的咒力让我气机一滞。
lines.en: Strange magic stalls my ki.

lines.zh: 饿起来的时候，连气都提不动。
lines.en: When I am hungry, I cannot even raise ki.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我的头发都立起来了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，我找不到方向。
lines.en: Nothing here. I cannot find any direction.
